concept.concept: A black mug with a minimalist gold-foil-style illustration of a star chart and text 'I Was Up at 3am and It Was Worth It'
concept.audience: Backyard stargazers and amateur astronomers who sacrifice sleep for clear-sky nights
concept.rationale: Astronomy passion community buys merchandise that validates their hobby dedication. Dark mug with gold aesthetic photographs exceptionally well. Gifting appeal is high as the holiday window approaches. Niche enough to feel special.
